diagnostic: SICdb false-alarm and missed-hypotension bootstrap diagnostic only
timing: After original results and rev8a audit; before this new diagnostic results
scenario: primary_5min overall, including known and unknown doses
resampling_frame: All original paired SICdb patients; include patients with zero endpoint denominator; never replace frame with endpoint-denominator patients
rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); original environment bit generator recorded at run
weights: rng.multinomial(N, numpy.full(N,1/N), size=min(50,B-b)); shared weights across all endpoints/strata
estimand: Pair-weighted ratio of weighted event counts to weighted eligible counts, not mean patient-specific rates
percentile: numpy.quantile finite ratios at 0.025 and 0.975, linear interpolation
invalid: Zero replicate denominator -> missing; report valid replicates
BCa: Same 2000 bootstrap ratios. z0 from strict-less plus half equal fraction; acceleration from delete-one-patient jackknife over the same full paired-patient frame. If not finite, mark unavailable; no replacement rule. Quantiles via linear interpolation.
logit_Wald: expit(logit(observed) +/- normal(0.975) * SD(bootstrap logits,ddof=1)); production boundary-only 0.5 event/non-event correction; no change to reported main CIs
contribution: Rank by endpoint-event counts; all contribution and deletion summaries remain in the private diagnostic directory and must not be released.
exclusion: Remove complete patient clusters of top1 and top5 event contributors, recalculate point estimate only; this is influence analysis not a revised target population
BCa_author_issue: Flag when either BCa endpoint differs from percentile endpoint by >0.05 absolute probability (>5pp)
scope_prohibitions: Do not edit main results or DOCX
No patient or replicate-level outputs outside restricted/rev8d_bootstrap
Do not attribute skewness uniquely to contributor concentration
No new raw-source query; reuse the existing source-audit report.
